title: The Polynexus ordered-pair formula for the contiguous-diagonal rook submonoid
exact_endpoint: polynexus_literal; source set bridge PNZ_source; polynexus_integer and polynexus_rational; polynexus_one
scope: For positive n, M_n is zero plus the n-by-n 0/1 matrices X(d,k,m) supported on one contiguous block of one integer diagonal, with printed signed bounds. psi counts ORDERED pairs of nonzero operands whose ordinary matrix product is nonzero. Then 120 psi(n)=(n+1)^7-n^7-(n+1)^3+n^3. The n1 case is proved; all-Nat integer/rational theorems and independent n0 controls are a canonical extension, not separate credit.
